---
title: "Calculate lipid concentration and flux from traits"
author: "Patrick Pata"
date: "2025-11-27"
output: html_document
---

This script calculates the carbon export following Tarling et al. (2022). Because the bin size of the UVP6 copepod observations are 5m, at each depth bin, calculate the total diapause respiration rate (ug C m-2) by multiplying the total of (individual respiration rate ug C s-1) / volume filtered in the depth layer (m-3) * diapause duration (days) * 5 m. The 5m bins are then integrated into 100 m depth layers. 

Note that repeated UVP6 profiles at the same station are averaged into a single station profile at the 100 m depth bin level. 

At each 100 m depth layer, the mortality is calculated based on the abundance of the depth layer and the average duration of diapause for the individuals in the depth layer. The overwintering non-predatory mortality rate (beta) = -0.001 day-1 according to Tarling et al. (2022). Visser et al. (2017) uses the mortality rate of 0.005 d-1 (higher mortality, stronger lipid pump).




Tarling et al. (2022) method for carbon export
1. The total respiration flux is the summation of the product of abundance * diapause duration * respiration rate at each depth layer
2. Overwintering non-predatory mortality rate (beta) = -0.001 day-1
3. The total flux of the stored lipid and structural carbon from overwintering mortality is the fraction of the abundance lost to natural mortality multiplied by either the stored lipid or structural lipid carbon mass.
4. The total C flux is the sum of the total respiration flux + total stored lipid mortality flux + structural carbon mortality flux (ug C m-2 year-1)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

# 2. Integrations: 100m bin and vertical profiles
```{r, fig.height = 6}
# Step 1. Calculate abundance, biomass, and respiration in 100 m bins

# 1.1 Integrate volume of water sampled to 100 m depth bins
volumes.df.100 <- volumes.df %>% 
  mutate(Depth_100m = floor(Depth_5m / 100) * 100) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(depth_height_m = 5 * n5mbins) %>% 
  select(-c(n5mbins))

# 1.2 Sum all individuals and C traits in a 100 m depth bin
df.100m.sums <- indiv_traits %>% 
  # only include Calanus spp
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  # Cap diapause duration to 240 days (for summary stats, already applied in the annual respiration calculation)
  mutate(diapause_dur_d = if_else(diapauseDuration_day > 240,
                                  240, diapauseDuration_day)) %>% 
  # bin to 100 m layers
  mutate(Depth_100m = floor(object_depth_max/100) * 100) %>% 
  # Summarize traits
  group_by(sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = n(),
            biomass_mgC = sum(prosome_total_mgC),
            structural_mgC = sum(structural_carbon_mgC),
            waxester_mgC = sum(waxester_mass_mgC),
            # Convert respiration from ug C to mg C 
            respired_C_mgC = sum(diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC) / 1000,
            # Calculate mean % fullness and prosome lengths
            mean_lipid_fullness = mean(lipid_fullness),
            mean_prosome_length_mm = mean(prosome_length_mm),
            mean_biomass_mgC = mean(biomass_mgC),
            # Calculate the mean duration of diapause (sd for mortality function)
            mean_diapause_dur_d = mean(diapause_dur_d),
            sd_diapause_dur_d = sd(diapause_dur_d), 
            .groups = "drop")

# 1.3 Calculate concentrations in 100 m depth bins
df.100m.conc <- volumes.df.100  %>% 
  # combine volume and 100 m bin sums (note that bins with zero values mean no Calanus spp observed)
  left_join(df.100m.sums, by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_100m)) %>% 
  # replace NA with 0
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>% 
  # concentration by volume (m3)
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance/Sampled_volume_m3,
         biomass_mgC_m3 = biomass_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         structural_mgC_m3 = structural_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         waxester_mgC_m3 = waxester_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         respired_C_mgC_m3 = respired_C_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3) %>% 
  # concentration by area (m2), convert mg C to g C
  mutate(abundance_m2 = abundance_m3 * depth_height_m,
         biomass_gC_m2 = biomass_mgC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000,
         structural_gC_m2 = structural_mgC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000,
         waxester_gC_m2 = waxester_mgC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000,
         respired_C_gC_m2 = respired_C_mgC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000) %>% 
  # Exclude the columns that are not concentrations
  select(-c(abundance, sd_diapause_dur_d, biomass_mgC, waxester_mgC,
            structural_mgC, respired_C_mgC)) %>% 
  # Zeros in the mean diapause duration, prosome length, and lipid fullness are NAs
  mutate(mean_diapause_dur_d = if_else(mean_diapause_dur_d == 0, NA, 
                                       mean_diapause_dur_d),
         mean_lipid_fullness = if_else(mean_lipid_fullness == 0, NA,
                                       mean_lipid_fullness),
         mean_prosome_length_mm = if_else(mean_prosome_length_mm == 0, NA,
                                          mean_prosome_length_mm),
         mean_biomass_mgC = if_else(mean_biomass_mgC == 0, NA,
                                          mean_biomass_mgC))


# Step 2. Calculate mortality for 100 m bins
beta <- -0.001 # natural mortality rate (day-1)

df.100m.conc <- df.100m.conc %>% 
  # 2.1. Calculate the fraction of the population lost to natural mortality
  mutate(mortality.coef =  exp(beta * mean_diapause_dur_d)) %>% 
  # 2.2 Calculate the abundance, structural, and lipid carbon lost
  mutate(abundance_m2_mort = abundance_m2 - (abundance_m2 * mortality.coef),
         structural_gC_m2_mort = (structural_gC_m2 - 
           (structural_gC_m2 * mortality.coef)),
         waxester_gC_m2_mort = (waxester_gC_m2 - 
           (waxester_gC_m2 * mortality.coef))) %>% 
  
  # 2.3. Calculate total carbon flux
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2 = respired_C_gC_m2 + structural_gC_m2_mort + waxester_gC_m2_mort) %>% 
  # NAs in total flux are zeros
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2 = if_else(is.na(total_gC_flux_m2), 0, 
                                    total_gC_flux_m2))


# Step 3. Combine profiles with the same sample_stationid_ed
df.station.100m <- df.100m.conc %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, station_year),
            by = "sample_id") %>% 
  select(-sample_id) %>% 
  group_by(station_year, Depth_100m) %>% 
  # Average all variables per 100m layer
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric),  
                   ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            nprofiles = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Establish factors
  mutate(Depth_100m = factor(Depth_100m, levels = seq(0,2500,100)))


# Step 4. Vertically integrate each profile (/m2)
df.profile <- df.station.100m %>% 
  group_by(station_year) %>% 
  summarise(n100mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3, na.rm = TRUE),
            abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
            biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_gC_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
            structural_gC = sum(structural_gC_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
            waxester_gC_m2 = sum(waxester_gC_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
            respired_C_gC_m2 = sum(respired_C_gC_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
            structural_gC_m2_mort = sum(structural_gC_m2_mort, na.rm = TRUE),
            waxester_gC_m2_mort = sum(waxester_gC_m2_mort, na.rm = TRUE),
            abundance_m2_mort = sum(abundance_m2_mort, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_gC_flux_m2 = sum(total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # The fraction of the population that experience mortality, the fraction of total carbon lost to C flux during diapause. Also fraction of the flux components
  mutate(we_perc_biom = waxester_gC_m2/biomass_gC_m2,
         fraction_dead = abundance_m2_mort / abundance_m2,
         fraction_C_flux = total_gC_flux_m2 / biomass_gC_m2,
         frac_resp_total = respired_C_gC_m2 / total_gC_flux_m2,
         frac_strut_total = structural_gC_m2_mort / total_gC_flux_m2,
         frac_waxe_total = waxester_gC_m2_mort / total_gC_flux_m2) %>% 
  # Add metadata
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              arrange(-maxSampleDepth) %>% 
              distinct(station_year, .keep_all = T) %>% 
              select(station_year, region.inuktitut, region.inuk, reg.inuk, 
                     Year, Month, 
                     longitude = object_lon, latitude = object_lat, 
                     maxSampleDepth, bottom_depth_m),
            by = "station_year")

# Percent of biomass below 200 m 
df.profile.200m <- df.station.100m %>% 
  mutate(depth = as.numeric(as.character(Depth_100m))) %>% 
  filter(depth >= 200) %>% 
  group_by(station_year) %>% 
  summarise(total_200m_biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_gC_m2, na.rm = T),
           .groups = "drop") %>%  
  full_join(df.profile %>% 
              select(station_year, region.inuk, biomass_gC_m2)) %>% 
  mutate(total_200m_biomass_gC_m2 = coalesce(total_200m_biomass_gC_m2, 
                                             0)) %>% 
  mutate(perc_biomass_200m = total_200m_biomass_gC_m2/
           biomass_gC_m2*100) 


# Step 4. Calculate regional averages
df.region <- df.profile %>% 
  left_join(df.profile.200m %>% 
              select(station_year, perc_biomass_200m), 
            by = "station_year") %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, region.inuk, reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            across(abundance_m2:perc_biomass_200m,
                   list(mean = mean, sd = sd),
                   na.rm = TRUE),
            min_biomass_200m = min(perc_biomass_200m),
            max_biomass_200m = max(perc_biomass_200m),
            .groups = "drop")

# Distribution of biomass below 200 m
clrs <- c("firebrick","#FF6800","#FFB300","forestgreen", "blue1","purple2","#F6768E")


ggplot(df.profile.200m, aes(x = region.inuk)) +
  geom_violin(aes(y = perc_biomass_200m, fill = region.inuk),
              alpha = 0.5, scale = "width") +
  # geom_boxplot(aes(y = perc_biomass_200m, fill = region.inuk),
  #             color = "gray30", alpha = 0.9, width = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = df.region, aes(y = perc_biomass_200m_mean)) +
  geom_linerange(data = df.region,
                 aes(ymin = perc_biomass_200m_mean - perc_biomass_200m_sd,
                     ymax = perc_biomass_200m_mean + perc_biomass_200m_sd),
                 color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clrs)
```

# 4. Summary stats of integrated values
```{r}
load("data/profile_integrated_cflux_20260511.RData")
# Average contributions ***
# 1. fraction of the biomass contributed to C flux
# 2. fraction of the total flux due to respiration, mortality
df <- df.profile %>% 
  select(fraction_C_flux, frac_resp_total,
         frac_strut_total, frac_waxe_total,
         region.inuktitut)

summary(df %>% select(-region.inuktitut))
sd(df$fraction_C_flux)
sd(df$frac_resp_total)
sd(df$frac_strut_total)
sd(df$frac_waxe_total)

# Are there regional differences in the fraction
df %>% group_by(region.inuktitut) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            frac_resp_mean = mean(frac_resp_total),
            frac_resp_sd = sd(frac_resp_total),
            .groups = "drop")


# Format csv for Table 3: Regional averages
table3 <- df.region %>% 
  mutate(abundance_m2 = sprintf("%.0f ± %.0f",abundance_m2_mean, abundance_m2_sd),
         biomass_gC_m2 = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",biomass_gC_m2_mean, biomass_gC_m2_sd),
         waxester_gC_m2 = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",waxester_gC_m2_mean, waxester_gC_m2_sd),
         total_gC_flux_m2 = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",total_gC_flux_m2_mean, total_gC_flux_m2_sd),
         perc_C_flux = sprintf("%.0f ± %.0f",fraction_C_flux_mean*100, fraction_C_flux_sd*100),
         perc_respired = sprintf("%.0f ± %.0f",frac_resp_total_mean*100, 
                                 frac_resp_total_sd*100),
         perc_structural = sprintf("%.0f ± %.0f",frac_strut_total_mean*100, 
                                 frac_strut_total_sd*100),
         perc_waxester = sprintf("%.0f ± %.0f",frac_waxe_total_mean*100, 
                                 frac_waxe_total_sd*100),
         perc_biomass_200m = sprintf("%.0f ± %.0f", perc_biomass_200m_mean,
                                     perc_biomass_200m_sd)) %>%
  select(region.inuktitut, n,
         abundance_m2, biomass_gC_m2, waxester_gC_m2, 
         total_gC_flux_m2, total_gC_flux_m2_median, perc_C_flux, perc_respired,
         perc_structural, perc_waxester, perc_biomass_200m)


write.csv(table3, file = "tables/Table3_regional_averages.csv")
```

# 5. Compare lipid pump distributions between regions
```{r}
# KW and Dunns test for significant differences in medians
df <- df.profile %>% 
  mutate(region = region.inuk)

# *** Carbon flux ***
kruskal.test(total_gC_flux_m2 ~ region, data = df) 
res.dunn <- dunn.test::dunn.test(x = df$total_gC_flux_m2,
                     g = df$region,
                     kw = F,
                     method = "bh")
subset( data.frame(comp = res.dunn$comparisons, p = res.dunn$P.adjusted),
  p >= 0.025 )



# *** Abundance ***
kruskal.test(abundance_m2 ~ region, data = df) 
res.dunn <- dunn.test::dunn.test(x = df$abundance_m2,
                     g = df$region,
                     kw = F,
                     method = "bh")
subset( data.frame(comp = res.dunn$comparisons, p = res.dunn$P.adjusted),
  p >= 0.025 )

# *** Biomass ***
kruskal.test(biomass_gC_m2 ~ region, data = df) 
res.dunn <- dunn.test::dunn.test(x = df$biomass_gC_m2,
                     g = df$region,
                     kw = F,
                     method = "bh")
subset( data.frame(comp = res.dunn$comparisons, p = res.dunn$P.adjusted),
  p >= 0.025 )

# % WE in biom
kruskal.test(we_perc_biom ~ region, data = df) # not sig diff

# % Cflux to total carbon biomass (amount of biomass contributed to C flux)
kruskal.test(fraction_C_flux ~ region, data = df) 
res.dunn <- dunn.test::dunn.test(x = df$fraction_C_flux,
                     g = df$region,
                     kw = F,
                     method = "bh")
subset( data.frame(comp = res.dunn$comparisons, p = res.dunn$P.adjusted),
  p < 0.025 )


# % respired to total C flux
kruskal.test(frac_resp_total ~ region, data = df) 
res.dunn <- dunn.test::dunn.test(x = df$fraction_C_flux,
                     g = df$region,
                     kw = F,
                     method = "bh")
subset( data.frame(comp = res.dunn$comparisons, p = res.dunn$P.adjusted),
  p < 0.025 )


# TODO test difference in relative contribution of flux components
```


## Anova Stat tests: LPC between subregions
```{r}
# Global
shapiro.test(df.profile$total_gC_flux_m2)
shapiro.test(log10(df.profile$total_gC_flux_m2))

# Per subregion
df.shapiro <- df.profile %>% 
  select(region = region.inuk, total_gC_flux_m2) %>% 
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2 = log10(total_gC_flux_m2))
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            # Shapiro-Wilk normality test on paired differences
            shapiro_obj = list(shapiro.test(total_gC_flux_m2)),
            shapiro_W = shapiro_obj[[1]]$statistic,
            shapiro_p = shapiro_obj[[1]]$p.value,
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(normality_ok = shapiro_p > 0.05) # interpret normality

df.shapiro

ggplot(df.profile, aes(x = total_gC_flux_m2, color = reg.inuk)) +
  geom_density() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs)
```


# 6. Profile metadata
```{r}
# Temporal frequency
df.meta <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  arrange(-maxSampleDepth) %>% 
  distinct(station_year, .keep_all = T) 

df.meta %>% 
  distinct(region.inuktitut, Year) %>% 
  arrange(region.inuktitut)

df.meta.months <- df.meta %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, Month_Name) %>% 
  summarise(nprofiles = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Month_Name, values_from = nprofiles) %>% 
  relocate(region.inuktitut, July, August, September, October)

df.meta.depths <- df.meta %>% 
  mutate(region = region.inuktitut) %>% 
  group_by(region) %>% 
  summarise(nprofiles = n(), 
            mean_bottom = mean(bottom_depth_m),
            sd_bottom = sd(bottom_depth_m),
            .groups = "drop") 

colnames(df.meta)
```

# 7. CTD metadata
```{r}
load("data/uvp6_associated_ctd_20260330.RData")

# Subset the CTD data to the 208 profiles analyzed
ctd_meta_208 <- uvp6_ctd_match %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% df.meta$sample_id)

ctd_208 <- ctd %>% 
  filter(filename %in% ctd_meta_208$ctd_filename) %>% 
  left_join(df.meta %>% 
              select(filename = ctd_filename, region = region.inuktitut),
            by = "filename") 

# Calculate mixed layer depth (MLD) based on sigma = 0.003 threshold
mld.df <- ctd_208 %>% 
  select(filename, cast_number, station, pressure, sigt) %>% 
  group_by(filename, cast_number, station) %>% 
  # Get MLD as 0.003 threshold
  arrange(pressure) %>% 
  mutate(
    sigt_ref = mean(sigt[pressure <= 5], na.rm = TRUE),
    delta_sigt = sigt - sigt_ref
  ) %>% 
  summarise(
    mld = if (any(delta_sigt >= 0.003, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      pressure[which(delta_sigt >= 0.003)[1]]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )


temp_thresh <- 0.2 

mldT.df <- ctd_208 %>% 
  select(filename, cast_number, station, pressure, te90) %>% 
  group_by(filename, cast_number, station) %>% 
  arrange(pressure) %>% 
  mutate(
    temp_ref = mean(te90[pressure <= 5], na.rm = TRUE),
    delta_temp = abs(te90 - temp_ref)
  ) %>% 
  summarise(
    mld_temp = if (any(delta_temp >= temp_thresh, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      pressure[which(delta_temp >= temp_thresh)[1]]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Average temperature above and below the mixed layer
df.ctd.mld <- ctd_208 %>% 
  left_join(mld.df %>% 
              select(filename, mld), by = "filename") %>% 
    mutate( layer = case_when(
      is.na(mld) ~ NA_character_,
      pressure <= mld ~ "above_mld",
      pressure >  mld ~ "below_mld") ) %>% 
  # assign below mld for NA values
  mutate(layer = if_else(is.na(layer), "below_mld", layer)) %>% 
  group_by(filename, region, layer) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_te90 = mean(te90, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_psal = mean(psal, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_sigt = mean(sigt, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_mld = mean(mld, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  group_by(region, layer) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_ctd = n(),
    mld_mean = mean(mean_mld, na.rm = TRUE),
    mld_sd = sd(mean_mld, na.rm = TRUE),
    temp_mean = mean(mean_te90, na.rm = TRUE),
    temp_sd = sd(mean_te90, na.rm = TRUE),
    sali_mean = mean(mean_psal, na.rm = TRUE),
    sali_sd = sd(mean_psal, na.rm = TRUE),
    dens_mean = mean(mean_sigt, na.rm = TRUE),
    dens_sd = sd(mean_sigt, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  filter(layer == "below_mld")

# Calculate temperature below 200 m and 500 m and upper 50 m Fluorescence... FLOR (ug/L) and CDOM

ctd.meta.50m <- ctd_208 %>% 
  filter(pressure <= 50) %>% 
  select(filename, region,te90,psal,flor,cdom,sigt) %>% 
  group_by(filename, region) %>% 
  summarise(across(te90:sigt, ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(region) %>% 
  summarise(across(te90:sigt,
              list(mean_50m = mean, sd_50m = sd), na.rm = TRUE), 
            .groups = "drop")

ctd.meta.200m <- ctd_208 %>% 
  filter(pressure > 200) %>% 
  select(filename, region,te90,psal,flor,cdom,sigt) %>% 
  group_by(filename, region) %>% 
  summarise(across(te90:sigt, ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(region) %>% 
  summarise(across(te90:sigt,
              list(mean_200m = mean, sd_200m = sd), na.rm = TRUE), 
            .groups = "drop")

ctd.meta.500m <- ctd_208 %>% 
  filter(pressure > 500) %>% 
  select(filename, region,te90,psal,flor,cdom,sigt) %>% 
  group_by(filename, region) %>% 
  summarise(across(te90:sigt, ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(region) %>% 
  summarise(across(te90:sigt,
              list(mean_500m = mean, sd_500m = sd), na.rm = TRUE), 
            .groups = "drop")


# Combine everything to a table with columns:MLD, Temp below MLD, 200m and 500m
df.meta.clean <- df.ctd.mld %>% 
  select(region, n_ctd, mld_mean, mld_sd,
         temp_mean_mld = temp_mean, temp_sd_mld = temp_sd) %>% 
  left_join(ctd.meta.200m %>% 
              select(region, te90_mean_200m, te90_sd_200m)) %>% 
  left_join(ctd.meta.500m %>% 
              select(region, te90_mean_500m, te90_sd_500m)) %>% 
  
  mutate(
    mld = paste0(round(mld_mean, 1), " \u00B1 ", round(mld_sd, 1)),
    temp_mld = paste0(round(temp_mean_mld, 1), " \u00B1 ", round(temp_sd_mld, 1)),
    temp_200m = paste0(round(te90_mean_200m, 1), " \u00B1 ", round(te90_sd_200m, 1)),
    temp_500m = paste0(round(te90_mean_500m, 1), " \u00B1 ", round(te90_sd_500m, 1))) %>% 
  select(-c(mld_mean:te90_sd_500m))


```

## Fig S1. Temperature profiles
```{r}
# TODO remove depths with low sample sizes
clrs <- c("firebrick","#FF6800","#FFB300","forestgreen", "blue1","purple2","#F6768E")

region_temp_profiles_5m <- ctd_208 %>% 
  # limit the mean+sd bottom depth
  left_join(df.meta.depths, by = join_by(region)) %>% 
  filter(pressure <= (mean_bottom + sd_bottom)) %>% 
  mutate(depth_bin = floor(pressure/5)*5)  %>% 
  group_by(filename, cruise_name, station, datetime, latitude, longitude,
           region, depth_bin) %>% 
  summarise(temp.mean = mean(te90, na.rm = T),
            temp.sd = sd(te90, na.rm = T),
            ntra.mean = mean(ntra, na.rm = T),
            psal.mean = mean(psal, na.rm = T),
            flor.mean = mean(flor, na.rm = T),
            oxym.mean = mean(oxym, na.rm = T),
            ndepths = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(temp.mean)) %>% 
  group_by(region, depth_bin) %>% 
  summarise(reg.temp.mean = mean(temp.mean, na.rm = T),
            reg.temp.sd = sd(temp.mean, na.rm = T),
            reg.ntra.mean = mean(ntra.mean, na.rm = T),
            reg.psal.mean = mean(psal.mean, na.rm = T),
            reg.flor.mean = mean(flor.mean, na.rm = T),
            reg.oxym.mean = mean(oxym.mean, na.rm = T),
            reg.nprofiles = n(), .groups = "drop")
```

## Calculate average temperature per profile
```{r}
ctd_208_200m <- ctd_208 %>% 
  left_join(uvp6_ctd_match %>% 
               select(Site, filename = ctd_filename), by = "filename") %>% 
  filter(depth > 200) %>% 
  # Rename station_year to match how these are coded for the UVP6 data
  mutate(year = year(datetime)) %>% 
  mutate(station_year = if_else(year == 2021,
                                paste(tolower(station), year),
                                paste(Site,year))) %>% 
  mutate(station_year = if_else(station_year == "de500/gliders 2021",
                                "de500 2021", station_year),
         station_year = if_else(station_year == "bb2 2021",
                                "de_bb2_float 2021", station_year)) %>% 
  
  group_by(region, station_year) %>% 
  summarise(temp_200m = mean(te90, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(temp_200m))

save(ctd_208_200m,
     file = "data/ctd_profile_mean_temp_200m_20260511.RData")
```

```{r}
clrs <- c("firebrick","#FF6800","#FFB300","forestgreen", "blue1","purple2","#F6768E")

# TODO Calculate community weighted mean of mean traits (weighted by abundance)
cwm.profiles <- indiv_traits %>% 
  # only include Calanus spp
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  # add volume filtered
  mutate(Depth_5m = floor(object_depth_max / 5) * 5 + 2.5) %>% 
  left_join(volumes.df) %>% 
  # add regions
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, region.inuk, reg.inuk, station_year)) %>% 
  # filter samples for analysis
  filter(!is.na(region.inuk)) %>% 
  # calculate portion of the volume to get relative abundance
  mutate(rel_abundance = Sampled_volume_m3) %>% 
  mutate(temperature_C = temperature_kelvin - 273.15) %>% 
  select(station_year, region.inuk, reg.inuk, rel_abundance,
         prosome_length_mm, lipid_fullness, waxester_mass_mgC, temperature_C,
         respirationRate_ugCday, diapauseDuration_day, 
         structural_carbon_mgC, prosome_total_mgC) %>% 
  group_by(station_year, region.inuk, reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric),  
                   ~ weighted.mean(.x, rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE)),
            nindivs = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

cwm.profiles.long <- cwm.profiles %>% 
  select(-c(prosome_total_mgC, structural_carbon_mgC)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(prosome_length_mm, lipid_fullness, waxester_mass_mgC,
                        respirationRate_ugCday, diapauseDuration_day,

  mutate(trait = factor(trait, 
                        levels = c("prosome_length_mm", "waxester_mass_mgC",
```

```{r}
biomass_vert_region <- df.station.100m %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  # Add metadata
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              distinct(station_year, .keep_all = T) %>% 
              select(station_year, region.inuk, 
                     Year, bottom_depth_m),
            by = "station_year") %>% 
  group_by(taxa, region.inuk, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(nprofiles = n(),
            across(Sampled_volume_m3:total_gC_flux_m2,
              list(mean = mean, sd = sd),
              na.rm = TRUE), 
            .groups = "drop")  %>% 
  select(taxa, region.inuk, Depth_100m, nprofiles,
         abundance_m3 = abundance_m3_mean, biomass_m3 = biomass_mgC_m3_mean,
         biomass_mgC_m3_sd,
         lipid_m3 = waxester_mgC_m3_mean,
         abundance_m2_mean, biomass_mgC_m2_mean, waxester_mgC_m2_mean,
         abundance_m2_sd, biomass_mgC_m2_sd, waxester_mgC_m2_sd) %>% 
  # calculate total across all taxa
  group_by(region.inuk, Depth_100m, nprofiles) %>% 
  mutate(total_abundance_m3 = sum(abundance_m3), 
         total_biomass_m3 = sum(biomass_m3),
         total_lipid_m3 = sum(lipid_m3)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(Depth_100m = as.numeric(as.character(Depth_100m)) + 50)
```

```{r}
df.profile.dbins <- df.100m %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  mutate(depth = as.numeric(as.character(Depth_100m))) %>% 
  mutate(depth_bin = if_else(depth < 200, "0-200 m", "200-500 m"),
         depth_bin = if_else(depth >= 500, "500+ m", depth_bin)
         ) %>% 
  mutate(depth_bin = factor(depth_bin, 
                            levels = c("0-200 m", "200-500 m","500+ m"))) %>% 
  group_by(depth_bin, sample_id) %>% 
  summarise(n100mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2),
            biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            biomass_WE_gC_m2 = sum(waxester_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            total_gC_flux_m2 = sum(total_gC_flux_m2),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Add metadata
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, region.inuktitut, region, Year, Month, 
                     longitude = object_lon, latitude = object_lat, 
                     maxSampleDepth, bottom_depth_m),
            by = "sample_id")


# plot total flux by depth bin

  # TODO Only consider profiles with sampling depths > 200 m ???

  summarise(n = n(),
            across(abundance_m2:total_gC_flux_m2,
              list(mean = mean, sd = sd, median = median),
              na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Calculate total and percentage of C-flux in the depth bin
  group_by(region.inuktitut) %>% 
  mutate(total_biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_gC_m2_mean)) %>% 
  mutate(total_biomass_WE_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_WE_gC_m2_mean)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%

  mutate(perc_tota_WE_biomass = biomass_WE_gC_m2_mean / total_biomass_WE_gC_m2 * 100) %>% 
  relocate(perc_total_biomass, perc_tota_WE_biomass)

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkturquoise","dodgerblue3","navyblue"),
                    name = "Depth Layer") +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  ylab("% Total biomass") + xlab("Region") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  coord_flip() + scale_x_discrete(limits = rev),
  ncol = 1, labels = "auto"
)
```

# 3. Vertical biomass profiles
Plot biomass and abundance with the non-calanus images
The lipid biomass profile will be very similar to the biomass profile. Because the bin sizes are similar, the /m2 concentrations will also be similar to the /m3, just * 100m. Some differences would be due to the last depth bins usually not completely 100 m.

## Fig 4. Biomass

```{r, fig.height=8}
biomass_vert_region <- df.100m %>% 
  # Add metadata
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, region.inuktitut, region, Year, bottom_depth_m),
            by = "sample_id") %>% 
  group_by(taxa, region.inuktitut, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(nprofiles = n(),
            across(Sampled_volume_m3:total_gC_flux_m2,
              list(mean = mean, sd = sd),
              na.rm = TRUE), 
            .groups = "drop")  %>% 
  select(taxa, region.inuktitut, Depth_100m, nprofiles,
         abundance_m3 = abundance_m3_mean, biomass_m3 = biomass_mgC_m3_mean,
         biomass_mgC_m3_sd,
         lipid_m3 = waxester_mgC_m3_mean,
         abundance_m2_mean, biomass_mgC_m2_mean, waxester_mgC_m2_mean,
         abundance_m2_sd, biomass_mgC_m2_sd, waxester_mgC_m2_sd) %>% 
  # calculate total across all taxa
  group_by(region.inuktitut, Depth_100m, nprofiles) %>% 
  mutate(total_abundance_m3 = sum(abundance_m3), 
         total_biomass_m3 = sum(biomass_m3),
         total_lipid_m3 = sum(lipid_m3)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  mutate(Depth_100m = as.numeric(as.character(Depth_100m)) + 50) %>% 
  left_join(region_rename %>% 
              select(region.inuktitut, region.color), by = "region.inuktitut") %>% 
  # Remove /n in the region name
  mutate(region.inuktitut2 = str_replace(region.inuktitut, "\n", " ")) %>% 
  # Relevel
  mutate(region.inuktitut2 = factor(region.inuktitut2, 
                                   levels = c("Nares Strait",
```

## 0-200, 200-500, 500+
Aggregate abundance to depth bins (note that this is /m2). Calculate the % of the population that was found in a depth layer.
```{r}
df.profile.dbins <- df.100m %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  mutate(depth = as.numeric(as.character(Depth_100m))) %>% 
  mutate(depth_bin = if_else(depth < 200, "0-200 m", "200-500 m"),
         depth_bin = if_else(depth >= 500, "500+ m", depth_bin)) %>% 
  group_by(depth_bin, sample_id) %>% 
  summarise(n100mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2),
            biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            total_gC_flux_m2 = sum(total_gC_flux_m2),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Add metadata
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, region.inuktitut, region, Year, Month, 
                     longitude = object_lon, latitude = object_lat, 
                     maxSampleDepth, bottom_depth_m),
            by = "sample_id")



ggplot(df.profile.dbins ,
       aes(x = depth_bin, y = total_gC_flux_m2,
           color = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color)) +
  facet_wrap(~region.inuktitut, scales = "free", nrow = 2) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  xlab("Depth (m)") + ylab("Total Flux (gC m-2 y-1)")


# calculate % of total flux per depth bin
AA <- df.profile.dbins %>% 
  # Only consider profiles with sampling depths > 200 m ?
  filter(maxSampleDepth > 200) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = abundance_m2:total_gC_flux_m2, 
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>% 
  
    group_by(sample_id, variable) %>% 
  mutate(total_value = sum(value)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(perc_total = value/total_value * 100) %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, maxSampleDepth, region.inuktitut)) %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, variable, depth_bin) %>% 
  summarise(perc_mean = mean(perc_total),
            perc_sd = sd(perc_total),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Table of % contributions to total biomass
table_df <- AA %>% 
  mutate( value = sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f (n = %d)",perc_mean, perc_sd, n)) %>%
  select(variable, region.inuktitut, depth_bin, value) %>%
  pivot_wider( names_from = depth_bin,
               values_from = value) %>% 
  arrange(variable)

# write.csv(table_df, file = "tables/vertical_bins_perc_total.csv")

AA %>% 
  filter(variable == "biomass_gC_m2") %>% 
  mutate( value = sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f (n = %d)",perc_mean, perc_sd, n)) %>%
  select(region.inuktitut, depth_bin, value) %>%
  pivot_wider( names_from = depth_bin,
               values_from = value)
```

# 4. Statistical comparison
##  4.1 Regional total C flux comparisons
```{r, fig.width= 8}
df <- df.profile %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  mutate(region = region.inuk)

# TODO properly account for which are significantly not different
# Abundance No sig diff: [Baffin Bay, Baffin Shelf, Davis, NOW] [Baffin sehlf - Lancaster]
# Biomass:  Mixed
kruskal.test(biomass_gC_m2 ~ region, data = df) # p = 0.01, no difference in distributions
res.dunn <- dunn.test::dunn.test(x = df$biomass_gC_m2,
                     g = df$region,
                     kw = F,
                     method = "bh")
subset( data.frame(comp = res.dunn$comparisons, p = res.dunn$P.adjusted),
  p >= 0.025 )

# Carbon flux
# No sig diff: [Baffin Bay, Baffin Shelf, Davis, NOW], [Baffin sehlf - Lancaster]
kruskal.test(total_gC_flux_m2 ~ region, data = df) # p = 0.01, no difference in distributions
res.dunn <- dunn.test::dunn.test(x = df$total_gC_flux_m2,
                     g = df$region,
                     kw = F,
                     method = "bh")
subset( data.frame(comp = res.dunn$comparisons, p = res.dunn$P.adjusted),
  p >= 0.025 )

# % WE in biom
kruskal.test(we_perc_biom ~ region, data = df) 
# % Cflux to total carbon biomass
kruskal.test(fraction_C_flux ~ region, data = df) 

# % respired to total C flux
kruskal.test(frac_resp_total ~ region, data = df) 
res.dunn <- dunn.test::dunn.test(x = df$fraction_C_flux,
                     g = df$region,
                     kw = F,
                     method = "bh")
subset( data.frame(comp = res.dunn$comparisons, p = res.dunn$P.adjusted),
  p < 0.025 )



# separate Baffin Bay/Shelf, Davis, NOW from rest
df  <- df %>% 
  mutate(region_set = case_when(
    region %in% c("Labrador Shelf","Lancaster Sound","Nares Strait") ~ "Group 1",
    region %in% c("Baffin Bay","Baffin Shelf", 
                  "Davis Strait","North Water Polynya") ~ "Group 2"
  ))

# Explore distributions
plot_grid(
  ggplot(df, aes(x = abundance_m2, color = region.inuktitut)) +
    geom_density() +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_color_manual(values = region_rename$region.color) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    facet_wrap(~region_set, ncol = 1),
  ggplot(df, aes(x = total_gC_flux_m2, color = region.inuktitut)) +
    geom_density() +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_color_manual(values = region_rename$region.color) +
    facet_wrap(~region_set, ncol = 1),
  rel_widths = c(1,1.6)
)


# Difference in %contribution of respiration to total C flux
kruskal.test(frac_resp_total ~ region, data = df) # p = 0.01, no difference in distributions
res.dunn <- dunn.test::dunn.test(x = df$frac_resp_total,
                     g = df$region,
                     kw = F,
                     method = "bh")
subset( data.frame(comp = res.dunn$comparisons, p = res.dunn$P.adjusted),
  p >= 0.025 )

```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
        axis.title.y = element_blank()
      )
  })

plots[[length(plots)]] <-
  plots[[length(plots)]] +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line()
  ) +
  xlab("Total g C flux (m⁻²)")


cowplot::plot_grid(
  plotlist = plots,
  ncol = 1,
  align = "v"
)
```

```{r}
                     kw = F,
```

## 4.3. Size profile-Region
 Regional differences is just comparing distributions of size and lipid fullness
```{r}
size.prof <- indiv_traits %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  mutate(temperature = temperature_kelvin - 273.15) %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, region) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            across(c(prosome_total_mgC, lipid_fullness,
                     respirationRate_ugCday, temperature),
              list(mean = mean, sd = sd, median = median),
              na.rm = TRUE))

# TODO statistical comparison
ggplot(indiv_traits %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus"), aes(sample = log10(prosome_total_mgC))) +
  qqplotr::stat_qq_point() + # Adds the data points
  qqplotr::stat_qq_line() +  # Adds the reference line
  labs(title = "log10(biomass)",
       x = "Theoretical Normal Quantiles",
       y = "Sample Quantiles (MPG)") +
  theme_minimal()


df <- indiv_traits %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  left_join(distinct(Amund_UVP6_meta, sample_id, Year))

# p = 0.01 difference in lipid fullness between regions, no difference in means
summary( aov(lipid_fullness ~ region, data = df) )
kruskal.test(lipid_fullness ~ region, data = df) # p = 0.01, no difference in distributions

# difference in total carbon (same results for prosome length and total diapause respiration for the year)
kruskal.test(prosome_total_mgC ~ region, data = df) # p < 0.001, diff distributions
res.dunn <- dunn.test::dunn.test(x = df$prosome_total_mgC,
                     g = df$region,
                     kw = F, list = T, table = T,
                     method = "bh")
# No sig diff: [Baffin Bay-Lancaster-Nares] [Baffin Shelf-Davis Strait] [Labrador-NOW]
subset( data.frame(comp = res.dunn$comparisons, p = res.dunn$P.adjusted),
  p >= 0.025 )


# FOR daily respiration rate, the pattern is different
kruskal.test(respirationRate_ugCday ~ region, data = df) 
res.dunn <- dunn.test::dunn.test(x = df$respirationRate_ugCday,
                     g = df$region,
                     kw = F, list = T, table = T,
                     method = "bh")
# No sig diff: [Baffin Bay-Baffin Shelf-Labrador], [Nares-NOW]
subset( data.frame(comp = res.dunn$comparisons, p = res.dunn$P.adjusted),
  p >= 0.025 )


df <- df %>% 
  mutate(region_set = case_when(
    region %in% c("Baffin Bay","Lancaster Sound","Nares Strait") ~ "Biomass 1",
    region %in% c("Baffin Shelf", "Davis Strait") ~ "Biomass 2",
    region %in% c("Labrador Shelf","North Water Polynya") ~ "Biomass 3"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(region_set2 = case_when(
    region %in% c("Baffin Bay","Baffin Shelf","Labrador Shelf") ~ "Respiration 1",
    region %in% c("North Water Polynya", "Nares Strait") ~ "Respiration 2",
    region %in% c("Lancaster Sound","Davis Strait") ~ "Sig Diff"
  ))

size.prof <- size.prof %>% 
  left_join(distinct(df, region, region_set, region_set2))


ggplot(df, aes(x = prosome_total_mgC, color = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_density() +
  scale_x_log10() +
    # Mean
  geom_vline(data = size.prof,
             aes(xintercept = prosome_total_mgC_mean, color = region.inuktitut),
             linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1) +
  # Median
  geom_vline(data = size.prof,
             aes(xintercept = prosome_total_mgC_median, color = region.inuktitut),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +

  facet_wrap(~region_set, ncol = 1)

ggplot(df, aes(x = lipid_fullness, color = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_density() +
  
  geom_vline(data = size.prof,
             aes(xintercept = lipid_fullness_mean, color = region.inuktitut)) 

ggplot(df, aes(x = temperature_kelvin-273.15, color = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_density() +
  facet_wrap(~region_set, ncol = 1)

# FOR daily respiration rate, the pattern is different
ggplot(df, aes(x = respirationRate_ugCday, color = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_density() +
    # Mean
  geom_vline(data = size.prof,
             aes(xintercept = respirationRate_ugCday_mean, color = region.inuktitut),
             linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1) +
  # Median
  geom_vline(data = size.prof,
             aes(xintercept = respirationRate_ugCday_mean, color = region.inuktitut),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~region_set2, ncol = 1)
```

## Separate flux by vertical bins
0-200, 200-500, 500+
```{r}
df.profile.dbins <- df.100m %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  mutate(depth = as.numeric(as.character(Depth_100m))) %>% 
  mutate(depth_bin = if_else(depth < 200, "0-200 m", "200-500 m"),
         depth_bin = if_else(depth >= 500, "500+ m", depth_bin)
         ) %>% 
  mutate(depth_bin = factor(depth_bin, 
                            levels = c("0-200 m", "200-500 m","500+ m"))) %>% 
  group_by(depth_bin, sample_id) %>% 
  summarise(n100mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2),
            biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            total_gC_flux_m2 = sum(total_gC_flux_m2),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Add metadata
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, region.inuktitut, region, Year, Month, 
                     longitude = object_lon, latitude = object_lat, 
                     maxSampleDepth, bottom_depth_m),
            by = "sample_id")


# plot total flux by depth bin
df.region.dbins <- df.profile.dbins %>% 
  # TODO Only consider profiles with sampling depths > 200 m ???
  # filter(maxSampleDepth > 200) %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, region, depth_bin) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            across(abundance_m2:total_gC_flux_m2,
              list(mean = mean, sd = sd, median = median),
              na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Calculate total and percentage of C-flux in the depth bin
  group_by(region.inuktitut) %>% 
  mutate(total_flux_gC_m2 = sum(total_gC_flux_m2_mean)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(perc_total_flux = total_gC_flux_m2_mean / total_flux_gC_m2 * 100) %>% 
  relocate(perc_total_flux)


# NOTE: the totals do not match the ones for Fig 5 because surface bins can be overrepresnted in shallow tows

ggplot(df.region.dbins,
```

```{r}
  select(sample_id, Depth_100m, 
         abund = abundance_m2, biom = biomass_mgC_m2, totalFlux = total_gC_flux_m2) %>% 
  mutate(depth = as.numeric(as.character(Depth_100m))) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = abund:totalFlux, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, variable) %>% 
  mutate(total_value = sum(value)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(perc_total = value/total_value * 100) %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, maxSampleDepth, region.inuktitut)) 

# vertical profiles per region
ggplot(df2 %>% 
         filter(variable == "biom") %>% 
         filter(maxSampleDepth > 200),
       aes(x = Depth_100m, y = perc_total,
           color = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  xlab("Depth (m)") + ylab("Biomass (mg C m-3)") +
  ggtitle("Average concentrations") +
  facet_wrap(~region.inuktitut, scales = "free", nrow = 2)

depth_totals <- df2 %>%
  filter(maxSampleDepth > 100) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, region.inuktitut, maxSampleDepth, variable) %>%
  summarise(
    above_100 = sum(perc_total[depth < 100], na.rm = TRUE),
    below_100  = sum(perc_total[depth >= 100], na.rm = TRUE),
    below_200  = sum(perc_total[depth >= 200], na.rm = TRUE),
    below_500  = sum(perc_total[depth >= 500], na.rm = TRUE),
    below_1000 = sum(perc_total[depth >= 1000], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

region_averages <- depth_totals %>%
  group_by(region.inuktitut, variable) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_above_100 = mean(above_100),
    mean_below_100  = mean(below_100),
    mean_below_200  = mean(below_200),
    mean_below_500  = mean(below_500),
    mean_below_1000 = mean(below_1000),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

# 7. Uncertainty ranges in respiration
Alternative version of section 2. The integration of the data but uses the minimum and maximum values for respiration flux. Only retain the profile and regional averages for comparison with calculations above.

```{r, fig.height = 6, eval=FALSE}
# Step 1. Calculate abundance, biomass, and respiration in 100 m bins

# 1.1. In each 5m bin, per taxa, per profile, get abundance and biomass
df.5m <- indiv_traits %>% 
  # Add column of the volume sampled in 5m depth bins
  mutate(Depth_5m = floor(object_depth_max/5)*5 + 2.5 ) %>% 
  left_join(volumes.df, by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_5m)) %>% 
  
  # Calculate total abundance and biomass per bin
  group_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = n(),
         biomass_mgC = sum(prosome_total_mgC),
         structural_mgC = sum(structural_carbon_mgC),
         waxester_mgC = sum(waxester_mass_mgC),
         respired_C_ugC = sum(diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC),
         respired_C_ugC_min = sum(diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC_min),
         respired_C_ugC_max = sum(diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC_max),
         .groups = "drop") 
  
# 1.2. When calculating at 100 m bins, make sure to add the empty 5-m bins sampled but with no observed copepods
df.5m.zero <-  volumes.df %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% indiv_traits$sample_id) %>% 
  # Repeat it 3 times for each taxa
  tidyr::crossing(taxa = c("Calanus", "Calanoida", "Copepoda")) %>% 
  select(-Sampled_volume_L) %>% 
  left_join(df.5m, 
            by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3, taxa)) %>% 
  # replace NA with 0
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) 

# 1.3. Calculate 100 m bin totals
df.100m <- df.5m.zero %>% 
  mutate(Depth_100m = floor(Depth_5m / 100) * 100) %>% 
  # Calculate concentrations per 100 m bin (note the number of 5m bins)
  group_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            abundance = sum(abundance),
            biomass_mgC = sum(biomass_mgC),
            structural_mgC = sum(structural_mgC),
            waxester_mgC = sum(waxester_mgC),
            respired_C_gC = sum(respired_C_ugC) / 1000 / 1000, # year-1 
            respired_C_gC_min = sum(respired_C_ugC_min) / 1000 / 1000, # year-1 
            respired_C_gC_max = sum(respired_C_ugC_max) / 1000 / 1000, # year-1 
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # This is more ideal because averaging the 5m bin concentrations results in slightly different values because the sampled volume is different per 5m bin
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance/Sampled_volume_m3,
         biomass_mgC_m3 = biomass_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         structural_mgC_m3 = structural_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         waxester_mgC_m3 = waxester_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         respired_C_gC_m3 = respired_C_gC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         respired_C_gC_m3_min = respired_C_gC_min/Sampled_volume_m3,
         respired_C_gC_m3_max = respired_C_gC_max/Sampled_volume_m3) %>%
  # To calculate /m2 abundance and biomass, multiple by number of 5m bins sampled
  mutate(abundance_m2 = abundance_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         biomass_mgC_m2 = biomass_mgC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         structural_mgC_m2 = structural_mgC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         waxester_mgC_m2 = waxester_mgC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         respired_C_gC_m2 = respired_C_gC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         respired_C_gC_m2_min = respired_C_gC_m3_min * (5 * n5mbins),
         respired_C_gC_m2_max = respired_C_gC_m3_max * (5 * n5mbins))

# Step 2. Calculate mortality for 100 m bins
beta <- -0.001 # natural mortality rate (day-1)

# 2.1. Calculate the average diapause duration of the invididuals in a 100m bin to calculate the mortality  coefficient for that bin
mort.diap <- indiv_traits %>% 
  mutate(Depth_100m = floor(object_depth_max / 100) * 100) %>% 
  mutate(diapause_dur = if_else(diapauseDuration_day > 240,
                                 240, diapauseDuration_day), 
         diapause_dur_min = if_else(diapauseDuration_day_min > 240,
                                 240, diapauseDuration_day_min), 
         diapause_dur_max = if_else(diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC_max > 240,
                                 240, diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC_max), ) %>% 
  group_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(diapause_dur_mean = mean(diapause_dur),
            diapause_dur_sd = sd(diapause_dur),
            diapause_dur_min_mean = mean(diapause_dur_min),
            diapause_dur_max_mean = mean(diapause_dur_max),
            nindiv = n(), 
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(mortality.coef =  exp(beta * diapause_dur_mean),
         mortality.coef_min =  exp(beta * diapause_dur_min_mean),
         mortality.coef_max =  exp(beta * diapause_dur_max_mean)) 

# 2.2. Calculate the fraction of the population lost to natural mortality
df.100m <- df.100m %>% 
  # Append the mortality coef for the population in 100 m bins
  left_join(mort.diap %>% 
              select(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m, mortality.coef,
                     mortality.coef_min, mortality.coef_max),
            by = join_by(taxa, sample_id, Depth_100m)) %>% 
  # Calculate the abundance, structural, and lipid carbon lost
  mutate(abundance_m2_mort = abundance_m2 - (abundance_m2 * mortality.coef),
         abundance_m2_mort_min = abundance_m2 - (abundance_m2 * mortality.coef_min),
         abundance_m2_mort_max = abundance_m2 - (abundance_m2 * mortality.coef_max),
         
         structural_gC_m2_mort = (structural_mgC_m2 - 
           (structural_mgC_m2 * mortality.coef)) / 1000,
         structural_gC_m2_mort_min = (structural_mgC_m2 - 
           (structural_mgC_m2 * mortality.coef_min)) / 1000,
         structural_gC_m2_mort_max = (structural_mgC_m2 - 
           (structural_mgC_m2 * mortality.coef_max)) / 1000,
         
         waxester_gC_m2_mort = (waxester_mgC_m2 - 
           (waxester_mgC_m2 * mortality.coef)) / 1000,
         waxester_gC_m2_mort_min = (waxester_mgC_m2 - 
           (waxester_mgC_m2 * mortality.coef_min)) / 1000,
         waxester_gC_m2_mort_max = (waxester_mgC_m2 - 
           (waxester_mgC_m2 * mortality.coef_max)) / 1000) %>% 
  
  # 2.3. Calculate total carbon flux
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2 = respired_C_gC_m2 + structural_gC_m2_mort + waxester_gC_m2_mort) %>% 
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2_min = respired_C_gC_m2_min + 
           structural_gC_m2_mort_min + waxester_gC_m2_mort_min) %>% 
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2_max = respired_C_gC_m2_max + 
           structural_gC_m2_mort_max + waxester_gC_m2_mort_max) %>% 
  # NAs are zeros because zero abundance in the 100 m bin
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>% 
  # Establish factors
  mutate(taxa = factor(taxa, levels = c("Copepoda","Calanoida","Calanus")),
         Depth_100m = factor(Depth_100m, levels = seq(0,2500,100)))

# Step 3. Vertically integrate each profile (/m2)
# TODO fix messy mgC and gC values
df.profile <- df.100m %>% 
  group_by(taxa, sample_id) %>% 
  summarise(n100mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2),
            biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            structural_gC = sum(structural_mgC) / 1000,
            waxester_gC_m2 = sum(waxester_mgC) / 1000,
            respired_C_gC_m2 = sum(respired_C_gC_m2),
            respired_C_gC_m2_min = sum(respired_C_gC_m2_min),
            respired_C_gC_m2_max = sum(respired_C_gC_m2_max),
            structural_gC_m2_mort = sum(structural_gC_m2_mort),
            waxester_gC_m2_mort = sum(waxester_gC_m2_mort),
            abundance_m2_mort = sum(abundance_m2_mort),
            total_gC_flux_m2 = sum(total_gC_flux_m2),
            total_gC_flux_m2_min = sum(total_gC_flux_m2_min),
            total_gC_flux_m2_max = sum(total_gC_flux_m2_max),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # The fraction of the population that experience mortality, the fraction of total carbon lost to C flux during diapause
  mutate(fraction_dead = abundance_m2_mort / abundance_m2,
         fraction_C_flux = total_gC_flux_m2 / biomass_gC_m2,
         fraction_C_flux_min = total_gC_flux_m2_min / biomass_gC_m2,
         fraction_C_flux_max = total_gC_flux_m2_max / biomass_gC_m2) %>% 
  # Add metadata
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, region.inuktitut, region, Year, Month, 
                     longitude = object_lon, latitude = object_lat, 
                     maxSampleDepth, bottom_depth_m),
            by = "sample_id")


# Step 4. Calculate regional averages
df.region <- df.profile %>% 
  group_by(taxa, region.inuktitut, region) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            across(abundance_m2:fraction_C_flux_max,
              list(mean = mean, sd = sd, median = median),
              na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

## Check range from respiration uncertainty
ggplot(df.profile %>% 
           filter(taxa == "Calanus"),
         aes(y = region.inuktitut)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(x = total_gC_flux_m2, color = region.inuktitut)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color)) +
     # Add average values for the region
    geom_point(data = df.region %>% 
           filter(taxa == "Calanus"),
               aes(x = total_gC_flux_m2_mean), shape = 17, size = 3, color = "black") +
    geom_linerange(data = df.region %>% 
                     filter(taxa == "Calanus"),
                   aes(xmin = total_gC_flux_m2_mean - total_gC_flux_m2_sd,
                       xmax = total_gC_flux_m2_mean + total_gC_flux_m2_sd),
                   color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,13,1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 8.5)) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    xlab("Lipid pump carbon flux (gC m-2 y-1)") + ylab("Region") +
  # Add the min and max total flux 
    geom_point(data = df.region %>% 
           filter(taxa == "Calanus"),
               aes(x = total_gC_flux_m2_min_mean), shape = 2, size = 3, color = "red") +
    geom_point(data = df.region %>% 
           filter(taxa == "Calanus"),
               aes(x = total_gC_flux_m2_max_mean), shape = 2, size = 3, color = "red") +
  
  
    geom_point(data = df.region %>% 
           filter(taxa == "Calanus"),
               aes(x = total_gC_flux_m2_min_median), shape = 4, size = 3, color = "black") +
    geom_point(data = df.region %>% 
           filter(taxa == "Calanus"),
               aes(x = total_gC_flux_m2_max_median), shape = 4, size = 3, color = "black")


ggsave("figures/Supp_fig5_total_flux_resp_uncertainty.png",
       width = 6, height = 5, units = "in", bg = "white")
```
